summary: Check sense 4 on the two awake participle examples
rationale: Both examples in this box bear sense 4, which in the supplied stem list means “sich etwas merken lassen”, negatively “sich weiter totstellen”. The examples instead describe being awake: PrS 75/6 explicitly says maḥiso with closed eyes; 21/12 says huwe qimo maḥiso and the translation “wach auf den Beinen”. There is no separate detransitive sense list. This evidence makes the sense assignment doubtful independently of the editors’ ACT??? notes; the proper participle category and sense numbering cannot be settled from the supplied material.

69/415 says the boy left nobody awake (lo ṭrele ḥa maḥiso), whereas the quoted sentence concerns the fox approaching a man who is awake with his eyes closed. The supplied PrS 75/6 matches that full sentence. Existing prs 217/35 may already identify the quotation in the entry’s pagination; 69/415 may intentionally be an additional attestation of maḥiso. Clarify its status rather than substitute the automatic match blindly.
